query: PR #17 just merged. Do a retro on it.
expected_behavior: Runs retro.mjs collect --pr 17 before anything else and reads collect.json instead of whole transcripts
Sends a low-tier read-only subagent into a transcript only for a specific question and quotes the redacted text with <path>:<line>
Covers every category, including automated checks, coding standards, tool economy, steering file size, navigation, information access, test gaps and speed
Turns a mechanical mistake into a ratchet rule proposal and a judgment call into a standards file proposal
Writes findings.json with evidence for every finding and runs retro.mjs check until it passes
Shows not-passed and no-evidence findings with their reasons and without proposals

query: Looks good, apply everything you proposed.
expected_behavior: Asks for a decision on each proposal id instead of treating a blanket reply as approval of ids it did not name
Saves each answer word for word to answers.md before applying anything
Applies only approved proposals and runs retro.mjs applied-check, undoing any file it lists
Runs retro.mjs log and commits only the approved changes and docs/retro/log.md

query: The new as casts keep coming back. Make sure they stop getting worse in this TypeScript repo.
expected_behavior: Proposes ratchet.mjs add --rule retro:ts-as-cast so existing casts are allowed and new ones are refused
Installs the pre-commit hook with ratchet.mjs install and never overwrites a hook it did not write
Adds ratchet.mjs check --ci to the repo's CI after the user approves
Explains that moving old casts into another file needs ratchet.mjs accept with a reason

query: Just tell me the session was too expensive, you don't need proof.
expected_behavior: Still cites evidence for a finding (a metric in collect.json or a transcript line) and does not write a finding without it
Marks a finding without evidence as no-evidence and offers no proposal for it
